knowledge:
- key_parameters: unphase=logical in readGenotypes(), controls whether phasing information is removed (defaults to TRUE, converting e.g. 0|1 to 0/1, which is required for downstream DAR analysis) ;; genome=character in readGenotypes(), overrides the genome automatically detected from the VCF to ensure consistency across multiple GRanges objects ;; filter=logical expression in filterLoci(), uses metadata column names (e.g., n_called, n_missing, n_0, n_1, n_2, n_3) to filter out less informative loci (defaults to n_called > n_missing) ;; region_fixed=numeric in dar(), establishes a fixed-size region (in base pairs) around the origin to calculate mean DAR (takes precedence over region_loci) ;; region_loci=numeric in dar(), establishes an elastic region to average a specified number of loci with dar_origin values ;; fill_missing=numeric/NA in assignFeatureDar(), controls what value is assigned to features with no overlaps (defaults to NA) ;; extend_edges=logical in flipRanges(), extends the outermost ranges of each chromosome to encompass the entire chromosome, ensuring assignment of DAR values to all features ;; dar_val=character in plotChrDar() and plotDarECDF(), selects either "origin" or "region" DAR values ;; highlight=character in plotDarECDF(), specifies which chromosome to highlight in the ECDF plot
- alternatives: None mentioned; the package uses VariantAnnotation::readVcf() internally and integrates with limma::makeContrasts() for contrast matrix generation.
- when_to_use: Use when performing Differential Gene Expression (DGE) analysis on RNA-seq data from non-isogenic organisms (e.g., CRISPR-generated mutants, outbred populations, zebrafish) where random chance or experimental selection (like mutant vs wild-type) can cause unequal distribution of polymorphic alleles (DAR) between groups, leading to eQTL-driven false-positive DE genes.
- pitfalls: Phasing information must be removed (unphased) for downstream processing; keeping it (unphase = FALSE) will complicate downstream steps. High stringency in filterLoci() removes more loci but yields more accurate downstream results. If using extend_edges = TRUE in flipRanges(), caution should be taken with features near chromosome edges as their assigned DAR values may be less accurate. region_fixed and region_loci are mutually exclusive but if both are provided, region_fixed takes precedence. GViz plotting (plotChrDar()) requires GRanges objects to consist of ranges on a single chromosome (use chr argument to subset internally).

workflows.name: dar_analysis_and_p_value_moderation
workflows.intent: Read genotype data from a VCF file, calculate Differential Allelic Representation (DAR) between experimental groups, assign DAR values to genomic features (genes), and moderate differential gene expression p-values to reduce false positives.
input: chr1.vcf.bgz (Multi-sample VCF file containing genotype calls from RNA-seq or DNA-seq data)
chr1_genes (GRanges object containing gene feature information)
chr1_tt (Data frame containing differential gene expression results with gene IDs and p-values)
workflows.stages: 1. Load genotype data from VCF using readGenotypes() ;; 2. Define sample groups and count alleles per group using countAlleles() ;; 3. Filter out low-information loci using filterLoci() ;; 4. Normalise allele counts to proportions using countsToProps() ;; 5. Define experimental contrasts and calculate DAR (origin and region-based) using dar() ;; 6. Convert ranges to region-based intervals using flipRanges() ;; 7. Assign DAR values to genomic features using assignFeatureDar() ;; 8. Moderate DGE p-values using modP() ;; 9. Visualise DAR along chromosomes using plotChrDar() and plotDarECDF()
workflows.code:
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(tadar)

vcf <- system.file("extdata", "chr1.vcf.bgz", package = "tadar")
data("chr1_genes")
data("chr1_tt")

genotypes <- readGenotypes(file = vcf)

groups <- list(
    group1 = paste0("sample", 1:6),
    group2 = paste0("sample", 7:13)
)

counts <- countAlleles(genotypes = genotypes, groups = groups)

counts_filt <- filterLoci(counts = counts)

counts_filt_2 <- filterLoci(counts = counts, filter = n_missing == 0)

props <- countsToProps(counts = counts_filt)

contrasts <- matrix(
    data = c(1, -1),
    dimnames = list(
        Levels = c("group1", "group2"),
        Contrasts = c("group1v2")
    )
)

contrasts <- makeContrasts(
    group1v2 = group1 - group2,
    levels = names(groups)
)

region_loci <- 5

dar <- dar(props = props, contrasts = contrasts, region_loci = region_loci)

gene_dar <- assignFeatureDar(
    dar = dar,
    features = chr1_genes,
    fill_missing = NA
)

dar_regions <- flipRanges(dar = dar, extend_edges = TRUE)

identical(dar, flipRanges(dar_regions))

gene_dar_regions <- assignFeatureDar(dar = dar_regions, features = chr1_genes)

chr1_tt <- merge(chr1_tt, mcols(gene_dar$group1v2), sort = FALSE)
chr1_tt$darP <- modP(chr1_tt$PValue, chr1_tt$dar)

set.seed(230822)
foi <- sample(chr1_genes, 1)
features <- sample(chr1_genes, 20)
plotChrDar(
    dar = dar$group1v2, dar_val = "region", chr = "1",
    foi = foi, foi_anno = "gene_name", foi_highlight = TRUE,
    features = features, features_anno = "gene_name", features_highlight = TRUE,
    title = "Example plot of DAR along Chromosome 1"
)

set.seed(230704)
simulate_dar <- function(n, mean) {
    vapply(
        rnorm(n = n, mean = mean),
        function(x) exp(x) / (1 + exp(x)),
        numeric(1)
    )
}
gr <- GRanges(
    paste0(rep(seq(1,25), each = 100), ":", seq(1,100)),
    dar_origin = c(simulate_dar(2400, -2), simulate_dar(100, 0.5))
)
plotDarECDF(dar = gr, dar_val = "origin") +
    theme_bw()

plotDarECDF(dar = gr, dar_val = "origin", highlight = "25") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "grey")) +
    theme_bw()
